articles.title: How food shortages reshaped India's agricultural policy
articles.description: In the mid-1960s, domestic foodgrain production was insufficient to meet demand. India depended heavily on imported grain. The crisis accelerated investment in irrigation, high-yield seeds and domestic agricultural capacity.

articles.title: New clean-energy programme expands grid-scale storage
articles.description: The programme supports battery storage connected to renewable power projects. Grid storage can reduce variability in solar and wind generation. The policy is relevant to energy security and India's climate commitments.
